description: Search ITALIAN public-sector tenders and contract notices from ANAC (Autorità Nazionale Anticorruzione), the national anti-corruption authority that runs Italy's public-procurement notice register (the "cig" dataset — one notice per CIG, Codice Identificativo Gara). ANAC exposes no live search of its own, so this answers from a locally refreshed recent-window copy (see data_as_of and the window fields in the response). Filter by free-text keyword (matched against the Italian title and CPV category description), CPV code or prefix (e.g. "45" for construction, "72000000" for IT services), buyer name substring (Italian spelling, e.g. "Comune di Milano", "ASL", "Regione"), Italian province code, and a publish-date range. Returns compact shaped notices: CIG, title, buyer, province/region, contract type, amount (EUR), status, CPV, publish date, offer deadline, and outcome if communicated. Call it_tender_detail with a CIG for the full record.

buyer.description: Contracting-authority (buyer) name, partial match, Italian spelling, e.g. "Comune di Roma", "ASL Napoli", "Ministero".

cpv.description: CPV classification code or numeric prefix, e.g. "45" (construction works), "72000000" (IT services).

date_from.description: Earliest PUBLISH date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 90 days before date_to.

date_to.description: Latest PUBLISH date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the newest date in the loaded window (see window_to in any response), which can trail today by months because ANAC publishes monthly bulk files.

limit.description: Max notices to return (default 20, max 100). Newest-first.

province.description: Italian province name as ANAC records it, e.g. "MILANO", "ROMA", "NAPOLI" (case-insensitive exact match).

query.description: Keyword(s), case-insensitive, matched against the Italian notice title and CPV category description, e.g. "ospedale", "pulizia", "software", "manutenzione strade".

name: it_tender_search
title: It Tender Search
